name: lanyard
title: Lanyard
description: A conference theme whose home page is a delegate badge hung from a woven burgundy lanyard: the event's name in heavy black print on a white card, date and venue below, and a gold-foil satin ribbon at its foot that leads to registration, on pale-grey exhibition carpet, with the hall lights dimmed after dark.

tokens.--font-display: heavy type: the event's name, page titles, section headings, speaker names, foil words and the words woven into the strap
tokens.--font-body: running text, the programme and the badge facts
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small spaced capitals: menu, badge date, day headings, places, buttons, tags, table headings
tokens.--color-bg: page background (pale exhibition carpet; a dimmed hall at night), also seen through each badge's punched slot
tokens.--color-fleck: the fine fleck in the carpet, and the line round the paper insert of the big badge
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings and the heavy rules: under the masthead, above lists and day headings
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the carpet: intros, post dates and summaries, places and notes in the programme, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, the current menu entry, tag outlines, list markers, quotation bars and focus rings (burgundy)
tokens.--color-rule: thin lines on the carpet: between programme items, posts and table rows, and under the reply links
tokens.--color-card-edge: the thin edge round every badge and the rule above its facts
tokens.--color-print: laser-print ink on a badge: name, invitation line, facts, the rule under the badge date
tokens.--color-print-soft: lighter ink on a badge: the address and notes about speakers
tokens.--color-satin: burgundy satin: straps, ribbons and buttons
tokens.--color-satin-sheen: light on the satin: the middle of ribbons and buttons, the edges of the straps
tokens.--color-satin-deep: satin in shade: the weave across the straps and the ends of ribbons
tokens.--color-foil: gold foil lettering on satin, the focus ring on a ribbon, and selected text
tokens.--color-metal: the bright middle of the metal crimp that gathers the straps
tokens.--color-metal-dark: the shaded ends of the crimp and the hook through each badge's slot
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--color-shadow: the shadow under each badge and inside its punched slot
tokens.--measure-wide: widest the masthead, home page and footer grow
tokens.--badge: width of the big badge on the home and 404 pages
tokens.--strap: width of each strap of the big lanyard
tokens.--drop: height of the lanyard from the masthead rule to the badge
tokens.--time-col: width of the programme's time column; a longer time wraps inside it
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of buttons, tags and code blocks
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks; also how far the lanyard climbs to the masthead
tokens.--space-5: large gap between sections and above the footer
